body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Gain +1 Fortitude and resist up to 3 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: An adjacent willing ally gains +1 Fortitude against one attack until the start of your next turn.
Reduce your next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Titan
rider.html: Assume Stone Mantle (upkeep 1): gain +1 Fortitude while your normal Movement is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1. Ending the Adaptation ends both effects.
